the frozen predictions, the model qwen3.7-flash, the prompt, the active extraction contract, or the freeze receipt
any evaluation threshold, metric definition or gate formula

preconditions_all_mandatory: Fix the fourth defect: either add the (v1.7, v1.7) pair and the new design's pair, or derive the allowed pairing from the design's declared active contract instead of a literal table. Pre-register with tests including a negative case that a genuinely mismatched pair still fails closed.
Extend the dry-run to walk the report-extension and metric-assembly stages, so no stage remains unwalked at the one-shot boundary. The dry-run must stay read-only and must never emit a scored report.

Rehearse the COMPLETE evaluation path, including report extensions, metric assembly and report serialization, against a synthetic but structurally identical copy of the frozen inputs placed outside the artifact root, and show it produces a report end to end. The only untested thing when the boundary is finally crossed must be the data, never the code.
Full Ruff, strict mypy and full pytest green.
Independent review of all of the above before the replacement round is executed.
execution_rules: The replacement round is one-shot with zero retries. If it fails again, it is recorded as a second failed round and this authorization is exhausted; a further attempt would require a fresh owner decision.

Whatever the metrics show, pass or fail, the result is recorded and reported honestly. A failing precision gate is an acceptable and expected possible outcome and must not trigger any change to thresholds, sample, prompt, model or gold.
No P4.2b or P4.3 unlock follows automatically from a passing result; those remain gated on the separate P4.1 acceptance.

who_executes.recommendation: Codex should execute the replacement round after the reviewer approves the preconditions, rather than the reviewer executing it as happened this time.
who_executes.reason: Separating the party that reviews readiness from the party that spends the single authorization removes the failure mode that produced this incident, where the same actor both judged the path clear and consumed the authorization.
